message.zh: 26.4.7 重要更新修复任务页礼物、未读提示与普通任务卡错位，并确保新任务全局置顶；同时包含多语言、生产购物清单、移动端显示与性能修复。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: The important 26.4.7 update fixes misaligned gift, unread-notice, and regular task cards and keeps all new tasks at the top. It also includes localization, production shopping-list, mobile display, and performance fixes. Update on Greasy Fork.
